data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for background audio playback with media controls.
data.what_it_does: Provides a way to run audio code in the background while the screen is off. It exposes a standard AudioHandler API that forwards media actions to your own player implementation and updates system notifications, lock screen, headset buttons and Android Auto/Apple CarPlay.
use_when: You need background audio that continues when the app is minimized or the screen is locked
You want system media controls, notifications, lock‑screen or Android Auto integration
You need a unified API that works on Android, iOS, web and macOS
avoid_when: Your app only plays short foreground sounds and doesn’t need background playback
You prefer a zero‑native‑code solution for simple audio
You already use a full‑featured media player that handles its own background service
strengths: Full platform support (Android, iOS, web, macOS, Linux via MPRIS)
Works with any audio engine (just_audio, flutter_tts, etc.)
Rich feature set: queue, shuffle, repeat, custom actions, lock‑screen UI
weaknesses: Requires native configuration (Android manifest, iOS background modes)
Adds complexity compared to plain audio players
May be overkill for simple use‑cases
data.setup_notes: Add Android permissions and notification channel in AndroidManifest.xml, enable Background Modes (Audio) in Xcode, configure AudioServiceConfig with channel IDs, and ensure a compatible audio player (e.g., just_audio) is used inside the AudioHandler.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Lightweight foreground audio player without background service overhead

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simple API for playing short sounds without native background setup

alternatives.name: audio_session
alternatives.why_pick_it: Manages audio focus and session but does not provide background service
